source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.4.5, printed page 309.

blocks.text: Ozone taqatwar oxidising agent hai. Kam concentration mein ghair-zehreeli hai, magar 100 parts per million se oopar zehreeli; yeh insanon aur paudon ko nuqsan deti aur rubber, kapre ke rang aur paints ki paidari aur shakal jaise maddon par hamla karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Ozone stratosphere mein hamari hifazat karti hai magar zameeni satah par nuqsan deti hai. Farq wazeh karein.
blocks.explanation: Stratosphere mein oonchai par ozone nuqsan-deh ultraviolet roshni ko satah tak pohnchne se pehle jazb karti hai. Zameeni satah par yeh dhoop mein NOx aur VOCs se bani secondary pollutant hai, aur taqatwar oxidiser hone ki wajah se phephron, paudon, rubber, rangon aur paint ko nuqsan deti hai.

items: Zameeni satah ki ozone: taqatwar oxidiser, 100 ppm se oopar zehreeli; logon, paudon, rubber, rangon aur paints ko nuqsan.
